messages:
jamie: Heads-up — I tripped over a weird payload shape when using the Python AsyncEmbeddingClient with our BatchHelper + rerank=True. some responses include a `rerank` block, others only the raw `vectors`.

jamie: quick snippet (async client + batcher):
```py
out = await aclient.embeddings.create(
    model='embed-small-v1',
    input=batch_inputs,
    rerank=True,
    batcher=my_batcher,
)
print(out)
```

jamie: outputs I've seen: either `{'vectors': [...], 'meta': {...}}` OR `{'vectors': [...], 'rerank': [{'scores':[...]}], 'meta':{...}}`. our rerank wrapper expects `out['results']` and fails with KeyError.

nikhil: interesting — sync client always returns `results`. suspect async pipeline bypasses the rerank-normalizer middleware when batcher handles splitting/combining. batcher may reassemble responses without adding normalized keys.

vera: also note: if a transient 502 happens we kick off retries in the async codepath that re-send entire batches. because the reassembly is positional-only (no per-request id), a retried batch can end up merged with a previous partial result and produce duplicate/shifted entries.

tony: can you paste an example of the merged/shifted payload? even redacted helps trace ordering issues.

jamie: here's one from a local run (redacted):
```json
{
  "vectors": [[0.1, -0.2, 0.03]],
  "meta": {"req": "r-123"}
}
// later combined into:
{
  "results": [null, {"scores": [0.8, 0.2]}],
  "vectors": [[0.1, -0.2, 0.03]],
  "meta": {"req": "r-123-retry"}
}
```

nikhil: yeah that shows reassembly mismatch + missing normalization.

vera: proposed immediate fixes: (A) make BatchHelper attach per-request uuids and preserve them through retries, (B) ensure async combine step runs the same rerank-normalizer that sync path uses, and (C) add strict pydantic-type checks on client responses so missing keys cause a clear error (fail-fast).

jamie: i've sketched a tiny repro in examples/py/embedding_rerank_async.py that toggles induced errors and switches between sync/async codepaths. will add unit tests that assert final shape includes `results` always. will send a PR.

ton y: created ticket: https://internal/issue/RI-3099 — "async batcher -> rerank parity + retry idempotency" (label: bug, area: python-sdk).

deploy-bot: issue RI-3099 created by tony.

nikhil: longer-term: unify response types in the SDK surface (same dataclass/pydantic model for sync+async return types) and document exact shape for embeddings+rerank combos. also add a small CI matrix exercising the batcher under fault injection (502s, slow shards).

vera: another DX ask: improve error text when rerank requested but no scores present. right now it's a KeyError in user code; we should raise a descriptive InferenceResponseError mentioning `rerank` was requested but missing.

jamie: agreed. short term workaround for callers: use `results = out.get('results') or out.get('rerank') or []` but that sucks. we'll push the SDK fix ASAP.

tony: assigning RI-3099 to jamie. target: small patch + tests within next sprint. please @eng-ml when PR is ready.

jamie: will do. linking initial branch when I open the PR.
